Name: (MOVED) Soft Coop Animals Recolour
Author: subarucrosstrekbiggestfan
Description:
This mod recolours ConcernedApe's coop animal textures and gives them a soft, new look! Only the white, brown, blue, and golden chicken are recoloured in the most recent version, but I will be adding the void chicken, duck, rabbit, and dinosaur very soon.

No edits need to be made to add these animal changes to your game, just unzip the folder and put the mod into your Mods folder.

Made with <3 by CharlieFromAus126.
